# sanparks-watch: the reviewed set for identify_test
#
# Every archived frame Jeremy reviewed by eye on 7 September 2026, taken from
# `dir /s /b frames\*.jpg hits\*.jpg` at 07:30 UTC that day.
# Format: <cam>/<YYYYMMDD>/<HHMMSS>   (HHMMSS is UTC, the join key)
#
# 4,109 keys from 4,258 files: 25 timestamps carry both a hits/ and a frames/
# copy of the same frame.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. tools/ground_truth.txt lists the 524 that contain an
# animal. Without this file, "archived and not in ground_truth" would mean
# "empty", and the archive keeps growing: every frame the watcher writes after
# the review would be scored as a confirmed empty it never was. A frame in
# neither file is labelled `unreviewed` and is excluded from all scoring.
#
# When a new review pass is done, append the newly reviewed keys here and the
# animal ones to ground_truth.txt. Nothing reads the order.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# APPENDED 20 September 2026: the Nossob review pass of 8 to 18 September 2026.
# Nossob only. The other two cameras are unchanged and still frozen at 7 Sep.
#
# 1521 keys, regenerated from the repo tarball rather than typed, so the set is
# exactly what tools/draw_boxes.py put on screen:
#   Pass B1  hits/ 8-16 Sep, unfiltered              751 files,  751 keys
#   Pass A   frames/ 8-16 Sep, --md-min 0.2          352 files drawn, of which
#            307 carry their own species/ row and 45 fell back to the hits copy
#            of the same UTC second and so add no key of their own
#   Pass C   hits/ and frames/ 17-18 Sep, unfiltered 477 files,  463 keys
#            (drawn 19 Sep 2026, after both days had closed, so the archive of
#            those two dates is the drawn set)
# Union: 1521 distinct keys.
#
# HOW THE 45 WERE HANDLED. tools/draw_boxes.py falls back to the hits copy's
# MegaDetector box when a frames/ copy has no species row of its own, so a
# --md-min pass over frames/ draws more images than there are frames rows. Each
# of the 45 shares its UTC second with a hits capture already listed here, and
# the key is the second, so they add nothing. They are second views, not second
# frames. Jeremy set them aside in review for the same reason.
#
# WHAT A KEY HERE MEANS. Drawn AND looked at. Frames below the --md-min floor
# of Pass A were never on screen and are deliberately absent, so this file
# still carries no empty that nobody confirmed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
